correctness.rationale: For connected weights, K=N(tr((L+J/N)^-1)-1) is strictly convex in individual edge weights since Laplacian edge coordinates are injective in a simple graph and trace inverse has positive quadratic Hessian. A global minimizer exists because K diverges at disconnectivity and graph symmetry forces the unique optimum to three edge orbits a,b,c. Direct eigenspace decomposition produces eigenvalues 0, ms a+2c, Na, 2a (m-1 copies), 2a+sb (m(s-1) copies). The transformed budget and positivity constraints reduce the c=0 face to A/a+Nm(s-1)/y with cost m(s+1)a+m(s-1)y/2=B; Cauchy–Schwarz gives T²/B at a*/y*. The all-parameter inequality 2<rho=y*/a*<ms proves b*>0 and strictly positive multiplier mu=N/y*²−N/(m²s²a*²)>0 for active spine constraint, satisfying the full three-variable KKT system; thus this is globally, not merely facewise, optimal. Independent exact-rational 6x6 Laplacian charpoly and inverse trace verified at m=s=2, and separately coded inequality checks covered every 2≤m,s≤19; finite tests support but do not prove the global integer range.
residual_risks: All edges have identical linear unit cost; different objectives or heterogeneous petals excluded.

Strict convexity applies in connected positive-definite Laplacian region and existence relies on objective tending infinite near disconnection; not true for arbitrary disconnected zero-weight supports.

value.rationale: Kirchhoff-index minimization is a natural practical/electrical network-design objective. A pre-existing dense hub edge strictly reduces resistance if added without cost yet receives exactly zero optimal budget; the theorem proves that counterintuitive network-support transition for an infinite structured graph family, excludes asymmetric improvement, and evaluates every positive conductance and optimal value explicitly. This is a substantive sharp structural design result, not a generic restatement of convexity.
residual_risks: Restricted to two hubs, m≥2 cliques of same size s≥2, identical linear cost, and all-pairs resistance target.

limitations: No nonlinear budget, heterogeneous petal sizes, directed graph, or alternative graph functional.
Existing universal convexity and matrix spectral tools not claimed as new.
Specialized unindexed network-design literature might imply an equivalent result.
